description: Render a URL at multiple breakpoints and flag content elements that are visible on desktop but hidden on mobile (display:none / opacity:0 / visibility:hidden / zero-size). Categorises each flag as 'likely-oversight' (content that vanishes on mobile — the hidden-on-mobile content bug) vs 'intentional' (decorative). Returns a table of selector / hiding-class / mobile-visible / desktop-visible / category. Requires headless chromium.
name: audit_responsive_visibility
